references.text: The same introductory formula where the Lord speaks to Moses, used consistently throughout Numbers to introduce divine commands.
Nearby context with the same formula where the Lord gives Moses instructions about the land of Canaan.
Parallel introductory formula in Leviticus where the Lord speaks to Moses.
Early example of the formula 'The Lord spoke to Moses and said' which establishes the pattern for divine revelation through Moses.
The Lord speaks to Moses about the borders of the land that Israel is to inherit, thematically parallel to the border description in Numbers 34.
